newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP Inc EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBP Inc EPS view cut.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Wednesday she cut her earnings estimates for beef and pork processor IBP Inc to $1.60 a share from $2.14 for 1997 and to $1.80 from $2.45 in 1998.
-- She also cut her third quarter estimate to $0.55 a share from $0.80 and her fourth quarter estimate to $0.35 from $0.64.
-- In a report, Wittenburg said she lowered her estimates to reflect higher interest expense for the Foodbrands America acquisition.
-- "Foodbrands, which on a pro-forma basis would probably have $800 million to $1 billion in sales this year, was added to IBP In the second quarter," she added.
